opus.problem: Gives the word away. The naming line 'the glory has departed from Israel' is the best-known fact about Ichabod, and his name itself means 'no glory', so this clue alone gives the answer. That breaks the rule that no single clue gives it away.
The cited verses (1 Samuel 4:18-19) do not mention Shiloh. The news reaching Shiloh comes from 1 Samuel 4:12-13, so the reference does not fully support the clue.
